verdict.rationale: Idempotency keys are a fair axis for a payments API like Lemon Squeezy, but nothing in the evidence pack documents idempotency keys or safe request retries. The dunning system's card retries are a different feature (retrying failed subscription charges), not API request idempotency, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
